kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أقشعر (form IVq)
# أَقْشَعِرُّ (ʔaqšaʕirru) /ʔaq.ʃa.ʕir.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# أَقْشَعِرَّ (ʔaqšaʕirra) /ʔaq.ʃa.ʕir.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# أَقْشَعِرِّ (ʔaqšaʕirri) /ʔaq.ʃa.ʕir.ri/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
